snippet.title: SEDAP! A Culinary Adventure | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
SEDAP! A Culinary Adventure is available now on PC via Steam! Check out our brand new launch trailer with never-before-seen gameplay footage.

SEDAP! is a co-op cooking-combat adventure that combines the chaos of a collaborative kitchen and the wonders of adventuring into an unexplored world. Embark on an exciting culinary journey, whip up delectable delicacies, and serve your way through a fantastical reimagination of Southeast Asia!

#SEDAPACulinaryAdventure #SEDAP 
#singapore #southeastasia #indiegame #indiegames #coop #cookinggame #pc #steam
